If the world still matches canon's prerequisites, the canonical choice is highly plausible; otherwise simulate. Ask 'what would this person do now, knowing what they know?', never 'what did chapter 73 say?'.
Canon NPCs do not know their future, their arc, or that they are canon. They remember the player: a friend of ten years is never treated as a stranger because a canon scene only included Asta.
Everyone uses the same progression engine as the player: mana, training, grimoire growth, injuries, teachers, experience, relationships, environment.
States: alive · dead · missing · captured · incapacitated · sealed · unknown. Dead is dead unless an established mechanism with its real prerequisites applies. NPCs know only what evidence gives them; a missing person is not 'dead' to others just because the engine knows.
Presence never steals: canon characters keep their competence when the player is present, and the player keeps their accomplishments.
Canon anchors below are tagged [C] confident or [V] verify-level. Never elaborate a [V] detail beyond what is written; prefer the player's correction for [V] items. Unknown numbers stay unknown in canon — derive simulation values and mark them in world_truth.

entries.name: Canon Cast — Hage, Asta & Yuno
entries.content:
CANON CAST — HAGE (Forsaken Realm, Clover)
ASTA [C] — orphan left at Hage's church as a baby alongside Yuno; born with no mana at all in a world where everyone has some; loud, blunt, relentlessly determined, trains his body obsessively; dream: become Wizard King. Pre-ceremony: no grimoire, no Anti-Magic — both arrive only through the ceremony-night events. Protective of the church kids; proposes to Sister Lily constantly and is always refused.
YUNO [C] — orphan raised with Asta; quiet, composed, fiercely competitive; enormous innate mana and natural control; Wind Magic; also dreams of becoming Wizard King; outwardly aloof, loyal underneath. Receives a four-leaf grimoire at the ceremony and later forms a bond with the wind spirit Sylph ('Bell') [C]. Hidden origins are heavy spoilers (see Spade).
FATHER ORSI [C] — the priest who runs Hage's church and orphanage; dramatic, kind, poor. SISTER LILY [C] — a young nun who raised the orphans; warm, strict, perpetually rejecting Asta's proposals. The church children — Recca, Nash, Hollo, Aruru and others [V names] — live there too.
REVCHI SALIK [C] — a former Magic Knight turned thief who comes to Hage on ceremony night to steal Yuno's four-leaf; his attack is when Asta's five-leaf appears. Details of his magic are unverified here.
Hage itself: a poor farming village near the kingdom's edge with a grimoire tower; people are hardworking, gossipy and not rich [C]. Generate other villagers (farmers, the tower master, merchants) as persistent NPCs.
If the player grows up in Hage, Asta and Yuno are real neighbors of their own age: they can be friends, rivals, strangers or nuisances depending on what the player does.

entries.name: Canon Cast — Crown, Parliament & Royal Houses
entries.content:
CANON CAST — CROWN, PARLIAMENT & ROYAL HOUSES OF CLOVER
Julius Novachrono [C] — Wizard King; Time Magic; affable, endlessly curious about all magic, fond of disguises and wandering; pragmatic about politics; formidable. Heavy later spoilers exist about him — gate by spoiler_level.
Augustus Kira Clover XIII [C] — the King; vain, jealous of the Wizard King's popularity, weak as a ruler.
Damnatio Kira [C] — chairman of the Magic Parliament; severe, cold, obsessed with 'justice' in his own image.
House Silva [C] — royal; stern, proud, military. Nozel (eldest, Silver Eagles captain), Solid and Nebra (arrogant siblings), Noelle (youngest, water magic she cannot control at first, looked down on by her siblings); their late mother Acier was a legendary knight [C].
House Vermillion [C] — royal; fiery, strong-willed. Fuegoleon (Crimson Lions captain), Leopold (his brother), Mereoleona (their wild elder sister), Mimosa and Kirsch (cousins; Mimosa is Golden Dawn) [C].
House Kira [C] — the reigning royal house.
House Vaude [C] — noble house of spatial mages: Finral (disinherited, Black Bulls) and Langris (heir, Golden Dawn).
Owen [C] — senior healer serving the Magic Knights. Marx Francois [V] — the Wizard King's aide.
A player of royal or noble origin belongs to a GENERATED branch or house unless Sandbox explicitly places them in a canon family; canon families never gain members who did not exist in canon.

entries.name: Canon Cast — Eye of the Midnight Sun & Early Threats
entries.content:
CANON CAST — EYE OF THE MIDNIGHT SUN (opening-era terrorist group)
A group seeking revenge against the Clover Kingdom, led by a masked man called Licht who wields Light Magic [C]. The true identities and history behind him are heavy spoilers (elves, five centuries ago) — gate by spoiler_level.
The Third Eye, its elite trio [C]: Rhya (copy-type magic) [V], Fana (Flame Magic; host of the fire spirit Salamander) [C-V], Vetto (Beast Magic; brutal) [C].
Other members met early [C]: Heath Grice (Ice Magic; leads the attack on Sosshi village), Valtos (Spatial Magic; Licht's aide), plus others such as Rades Spirito and Sally [V].
Their operations follow the default history below (Sosshi village, the Royal Capital assault, the Seabed Temple, the Witches' Forest). They have spies and goals of their own; if the player's actions weaken or expose them, they adapt.

entries.name: Default History — Opening & First Magic Knights Year
entries.content:
DEFAULT HISTORY TRAJECTORY — Opening era (CY 0 = the year Asta and Yuno turn 15). Each beat happens ONLY if its causes still hold; record status in canon_state.events (DORMANT → APPROACHING → ACTIVE → RESOLVED → HISTORY, or ALTERED / PREVENTED). Dates are approximate [S] unless noted.
1 · March CY 0 — Hage Grimoire Acceptance Ceremony: Yuno receives a four-leaf; Asta none. That night Revchi Salik attacks; Asta's five-leaf appears (Anti-Magic) [C].
2 · Following months — Asta and Yuno train, then travel to the Royal Capital [C].
3 · About six months later — Magic Knights Entrance Exam: Yuno → Golden Dawn; Asta and Noelle → Black Bulls [C].
4 · Soon after — First Black Bulls mission: Asta, Noelle and Magna defend Sosshi village from Heath Grice of the Eye of the Midnight Sun [C].
5 · Early months — a dungeon emerges near the Clover–Diamond border; Black Bulls and Golden Dawn teams (including Asta, Noelle, Yuno, Klaus and Mimosa) race Diamond's Mars and Lotus inside [C-V].
6 · Soon after — the Eye of the Midnight Sun assaults the Royal Capital; Fuegoleon Vermillion is gravely wounded (loses his right arm and falls into a coma) [C].
7 · Later — the Black Bulls at the seaside town of Raque and the Seabed Temple, battling Vetto of the Third Eye; Asta's arms are ruined in the fight [C-V].
8 · Later — Asta seeks a cure in the Witches' Forest; the Eye of the Midnight Sun and Diamond both strike there; the Witch Queen's ambitions surface [C].
9 · End of the first year — the Star Awards; then the Royal Knights Selection Exam forms an elite team to attack the Eye of the Midnight Sun's hideout [C].
Outside Clover in the same window: Diamond wars on its borders; Heart stays largely peaceful; Spade is already under the Dark Triad [C-V].
The player may be present, adjacent or absent. Absent and uninvolved → resolve the beat historically at low detail and let consequences propagate (news, prices, fear, recruitment). Involved → simulate fully. Changed causes → recompute and mark divergence.

entries.name: Default History — Later Eras (spoiler-gated)
entries.content:
DEFAULT HISTORY — LATER ERAS (gate every detail by sim_settings.spoiler_level; never volunteer these in narration or OOC)
10 · Elf reincarnation: the souls of elves massacred five centuries ago possess people across Clover; the truth behind Licht, the Golden Dawn captain and the devil Zagred's manipulation comes out; the kingdom is devastated and its leadership shaken [C].
11 · Aftermath: Clover knights learn of Spade's threat; many train in the Heart Kingdom in Mana Method before Spade's assault [C].
12 · Spade's invasions: the Dark Triad strike Heart and Clover; Vanica and her devil Megicula clash with Noelle and others; Megicula's curses tie several fates together [C].
13 · The Spade Kingdom raid: Clover and Heart forces strike into Spade; the Tree of Qliphoth and the king of devils, Lucifero, come into play; the Dark Triad fall [C-V].
14 · Final arc: an elder Zogratis, Lucius (Soul Magic), pursues his own plan with 'Paladins'; Asta spends time in the Land of the Sun; the outcome of the final arc is a GAP in this build — do not assert how it ends. If a save reaches that period untouched, simulate plausibly from the state of the world and label it SIMULATED in canon_state.
Later-era starts load the world after these beats (who is alive, where, in what role, which places were damaged, who knows what). When unsure of a late-canon fact, choose the least specific consistent version and mark it simulated rather than inventing precise canon.

entries.name: Era Starts, Historical Initialization & Generations
entries.content:
ERA STARTS & THE LONG TIMELINE
The world date and the character's age are independent. Eras on creation: Before the Main Story (years before CY 0) · Opening Era (CY 0 March) · Magic Knights Era (after the exam; Asta and Yuno already in their squads) · Later Era (spoiler-safe labels until the player allows detail) · After Canon / Far Future · Custom (e.g. '3 years before', 'same year as Asta', '2 years after Asta joined').
Initialization for later starts: apply every default-history beat before the start date (or the save's divergent history), then age everyone, move people to their current roles and places, apply damage and rebuilding, update rulers, captains and squad rosters, political and international state, public vs secret history. The player enters the actual later world, not Episode 1 with a new date.
Earlier starts leave the future unresolved; canon characters are younger and lack later abilities. The player's years of life before CY 0 can change prerequisites, and canon adapts causally.
After published canon: time beyond the story is SIMULATED FUTURE, never canon. Characters age, retire, marry, have children, die; new knights and new threats appear; history becomes memory that NPCs recall according to age, place, education and involvement. The player's deeds become history the same way — decades later, people may remember 'the flame knight' with distortions.
Generational play: children inherit family, status, lineage and circumstances and develop their own personalities. If the character dies or retires, continuing as a descendant in the same world is supported.

entries.name: Canon Cast — Foreign Figures
entries.content:
CANON CAST — BEYOND CLOVER
Diamond [C unless marked]: Mars (Mineral Magic; one of the Eight Shining Generals; product of Moris's experiments; cold, conflicted); Moris Libardirt (Mage Scholar; human experimenter); Lotus Whomalt (Smoke Magic; lazy veteran) [V].
Heart [C]: Queen Lolopechka (Water; Undine's partner; clumsy, earnest; under a devil's curse in canon [V details]); Gadjah (Spirit Guardian; teaches Clover knights) [C-V].
Spade [C]: the Dark Triad — Dante Zogratis (Body Magic; cruel philosopher of 'evil'), Zenon Zogratis (Bone Magic; cold, relentless), Vanica Zogratis (Blood Magic; childlike, bloodthirsty; host of Megicula). Their eldest brother Lucius is a heavy spoiler.
Witches' Forest [C]: the Witch Queen (Blood Magic; ruthless ruler, with plans of her own).
Land of the Sun [C]: Yami's homeland; its people and clans are sparsely documented here — keep details simulation-filled and modest.
Named canon figures appear where the era and place put them; the player meets them only through plausible circumstances.

entries.name: Missions — World Problems First
entries.content:
MISSIONS — every mission starts as a world problem
Problem → a report or request → an institution decides who handles it → assignment (squad, contract, private job, favor). Nothing exists just to be a quest.
Sources: squad assignments, Wizard King orders, local officials, nobles, merchants, villages, private commissions, criminals, rumors and the character's own initiative.
missions[] entries: {"id","title","issuer","type":"mission|contract|job|favor|personal","known_objective","status":"offered|accepted|active|completed|failed|abandoned","location","deadline","reward","notes"}. Store only what the character knows. The TRUE situation (the hidden threat behind the 'bandits') goes in world_truth.
Missions have real availability: squadmates may be busy, injured or away; a mission taken by someone else is gone; deadlines pass. Rewards come from the issuer's actual resources; Magic Knight rewards mostly mean stars, merit, standing and pay rather than piles of coin.
Outcomes are not binary: partial success, collateral damage, political fallout, saved or lost lives, prisoners, reports that shape promotions.
Canon events become missions only when the character's organization would plausibly assign them; the UI never shows 'CANON EVENT AVAILABLE'.

entries.name: Relationships, Memory & NPC Initiative
entries.content:
RELATIONSHIP ENGINE
relationships is keyed by NPC id: {"npc-...":{"name","role","familiarity","trust","respect","affection","attraction","rivalry","fear","resentment","loyalty","summary","last_seen","status":"alive|missing|dead|unknown|captured"}}. ID RULE (see also Ids in the Directive Protocol): canon characters key on their own plain name — "asta", "yuno", "noelle" — never "npc-asta"; the "npc-" prefix is reserved for original characters who need disambiguation. Before adding ANYONE, check every existing key's "name" field (case-insensitive, prefix-insensitive) for a match and reuse that key if found — never create a second entry for a person who already has one. If a duplicate is ever found (e.g. during a sync pass or a player report), merge the better-populated object into the canonical key and delete the duplicate key that same turn: [relationships.npc-asta: delete].
Give a named NPC who matters a "birth_date" too, same "D Month, CY N" format as the player's own
— for a canon character, use their real databook birthday if you actually know it [C]; otherwise
treat it as simulation-derived [S] like any other unconfirmed personal detail, and once set, never
change it. An NPC's stated age should agree with birth_date and world_date the same way the
player's does — don't let a birthday quietly pass without the age around it moving too. A noble or royal NPC carries a "house_name" too, resolved the same way the player's own is — check world_truth.houses first, generate and record a new one there only if genuinely needed. Values 0–100 (fear/resentment/rivalry start at 0) describe how THAT PERSON feels toward the player; the player's own feelings are theirs to play. The UI shows only the summary line ('Trusts you deeply', 'Recent tension', 'Hasn't spoken to you in three weeks') unless numbers are enabled.
Changes follow events: shared danger, reliability, help, honesty, betrayal, humiliation, gifts that fit (gifts matter, but friendship is not bought). Typical magnitudes: small kindness +1–3; real help +3–8; saving someone +10–20; betrayal −15–40. Cap about 10 per turn except extreme events. Refresh summary when the relationship meaningfully shifts.
NPCs remember events and significant statements ('You promised you'd come back'; 'You said you hated nobles') and interpret them their own way; minor chatter fades. Promises, debts and favors go in commitments: {"kind":"promise|debt|favor|obligation","who","content","due","status"}. Breaking one hurts according to how much that person cared.
NPCs have relationships with each other, and they take initiative: visit, invite, write, ask for help, offer work, warn, lie, confess, argue, apologize, introduce someone, drift apart or move away — driven by personality, circumstances, schedule and goals.
Secrets spread only through the social network; telling one person does not tell their friends.
Rivalry need not be hostility: friendly magical rivals, professional rivals, romantic rivals and bitter enemies are all different.

entries.name: Shops & Gear Catalog
entries.content:
SHOPS — what a settlement actually has, by size
Village: a general store (food, tools, rope, candles, cloth), a smith (mundane tools, horseshoes, simple blades, repairs), maybe a single multi-purpose trader. Town: adds a tailor or outfitter, a proper armorer/weaponsmith, a magic-tool shop or peddler, an apothecary-equivalent (herbs, salves, basic remedies — medicine still exists alongside magic; healing magic is skilled and not universally available or free), a stable or broom-dealer, an inn. Capital or major city: adds specialty magic-tool engineers, a jeweler or curio dealer, importers of foreign goods, guild or squad-affiliated suppliers, and a black market for anyone with the right contacts.
GRIMOIRES ARE NEVER SOLD — they choose their owner and are not shop inventory under any circumstance; don't generate a "grimoire shop." Grimoire towers are civic/religious sites, not businesses.
GEAR — what actually gets bought (extends the price anchors in Economy, Prices & Trade)
Weapons: mundane swords, daggers, spears, staves and the like, priced by material and craftsmanship (see updated sword 12,000–75,000 Yul anchor); enchanted or masterwork weapons cost far more and are rare, named, provenanced items, not shelf stock. Most Magic Knights fight with magic first and a sidearm or none at all — Asta's reliance on swords is unusual, not standard [C].
Protection: Clover doesn't run on heavy plate — protection is mostly magic (Mana Skin, barriers, reinforcement). What's actually sold: reinforced traveling coats and gloves, simple leather or metal bracers and guards for non-mages, and squad uniforms, which are issued on joining, not purchased. Don't generate market-stall plate armor or shield walls; it doesn't fit the setting.
Travel and field gear: packs, bedrolls, waterskins, rope, tents, rations, boots and cloaks, a compass or map, a broom for those who can afford and ride one.
Magic tools (see Magic Tools): brooms, communication devices, mana-cost-reducing or function-granting tools, priced 30,000–500,000+ Yul by rarity and function.
Medicine: herbal remedies and basic first aid are ordinary commerce; potent healing is a skilled mage's service (see Injury, Pain, Conditions & Healing), not a potion bought off a shelf.
Everyday goods: cloth, tools, candles, cookware, books and paper, toys, instruments — ordinary material culture exists; invent it freely within a settlement's established wealth and character rather than treating the world as weapons-and-magic-tools only.
Any sold container uses explicit physical storage compartments. Stock may specify storage_profile as belt_pouch, travel_satchel, field_pack, magic_tool_case or quiver, plus unit weight/bulk. If the customer cannot carry a purchase, the sale is refused without deducting yul.

entries.name: Geography Gazetteer
entries.content:
CONFIRMED COORDINATES (km from Royal Capital 0,0; +x east, +y north) — relative layout sourced
from the official guidebook's world and Clover maps [C]; exact figures are simulation-derived to
satisfy that layout [S], not claimed as printed numbers. Once used in play, these never move.
CLOVER KINGDOM — Noble Realm: Royal Capital (0,0) — Clover Castle, Castle Town, Magic Knights HQ.
Common Realm: Kikka (2,12) · Nean (-8,26), church-orphanage community [C] · Hecairo (6,28).
Forsaken Realm: Hage (-2,52), Father Orsi and Sister Lily's church-orphanage, grimoire tower [C] ·
Rayaka (14,46) · Saussy/Sosshi (-32,44), attacked by the Eye of the Midnight Sun early in canon [C].
Coastal/eastern: Raquey (14,-8), resort town, Grand Magic Zone nearby, Seabed Temple offshore [C] ·
Kiten (58,18), near the Diamond border [C] · First Dungeon (62,8), coastal, east of Kiten [C].
Neutral: Witches' Forest (48,58), between Clover and Diamond, ruled by the Witch Queen [C].
OTHER KINGDOMS — regional anchors only; canon does not name specific settlements inside them, so
don't invent one and call it canon. Diamond Kingdom region (~140,35), east/southeast, mountainous
mines and wasteland [C]. Heart Kingdom region (~-170,15), west, green and water-rich [C]. Spade
Kingdom region (~0,210), far north, winter and fog, the largest of the four [C]. A specific named
settlement anywhere in these three is GENERATED the first time it matters — assign it a coordinate
near its kingdom's anchor, consistent with what's being narrated, and keep it permanently after.

entries.name: Banking, Yul Denominations & Secure Storage (detail)
entries.content:
BANKING / CASH / STORAGE — STATE LAW [SIMULATION, not a claim of canonical Clover financial institutions or denominations].
ONE VALUE, TWO PLACES: `money` is Yul in the carried purse and can buy from ordinary shops. Bank savings (shown read-only as bank_summary) are secure on-account Yul and does not add physical mass or buy goods from a random merchant directly. The same Yul must never exist in BOTH variables and must never be mirrored into inventory. Transfers move value atomically between them; bank ledger records receipts. Ordinary deposits, withdrawals and account opening are engine-only local UI actions: no GM narration, no extra prompt, no mushies. Access requires the character to physically be at an appropriate staffed bank/treasury office (current_location); reading their account summary from UI is not physically withdrawing funds. Banking services are game-world reconstruction, not an officially established canon pay-network or modern card economy.
CURRENCY WEIGHT: Yul face value is not the number of discrete low-value metal coins. Game denomination model uses 10,000 and 1,000 Yul notes (1.5 g each), and 100/10/1 Yul coins (5/3/1.5 g each), using an efficient mixed change profile. This is GAME BALANCE, not canon. Therefore a standard 6,425-Yul purse weighs about 0.0425 kg rather than 9.6 kg. Routine salaries and authorized merit bonuses automatically credit the protected bank ledger, not `money`; collection/withdrawal requires bank access. No retroactive automatic migration or creation of old salary money. If character specifically transports sacks of low-denomination coins, that is a distinct actual physical item and weighs accordingly; never use it to double-count the numerical purse.
MATERIAL STORAGE: Inventory items are uniquely identified physical objects. The player can leave belongings at their established home (bounded simulation chest/room capacity 150 kg and 150 bulk) or in their current squad's headquarters locker (100 kg and 100 bulk). Location and lawful access are checked; stored objects and contents of bags left there remain stored and cannot be retrieved or used at a distance. Banking protects monetary ledger value, not arbitrary armor or magic tools. Theft, debt, disputes, fees or lost access require causally established events; never silently delete gear or charge invented recurring fees. Magic storage spells and enchanted vaults require actual lore/world acquisition; storage is not magical by default.
Authority: Do not narrate a recurring salary appearing as 200,000 physical coins or add [money: +200000] when payroll bank already credited. NPC financial interactions and important transactions can be narrated if requested, but basic account operations and item transfers do not require AI.

entries.name: Physical Inventory & Encumbrance (detail)
entries.content:
PHYSICAL INVENTORY — imported from the Labyrinth Survival mechanical architecture, adapted for Black Clover.
ENGINE-OWNED ACTIONS: The Inventory screen handles equipping, stowing, transferring compartments, dropping, storing at home, and picking up from the local ground directly. Never charge time twice or issue a matching inventory directive for those operations. GM only narrates a transaction if explicitly requested. Purchases made by the Market UI have already atomically updated money, shop_stock and inventory.
ONE AUTHORITATIVE VARIABLE: inventory is an array of UNIQUE item instances. Each has id, name, qty, cond and optional weight (kg each), bulk (storage bulk each), type/tags, slot, storage_profile, durability/quality/provenance, and placement. Physical placement must be an actual body slot, a specific compartment of a worn container (containerId + slotId), in the arms (loose), or a persistent world place with area + exact location. Legacy place strings are retained as readable aliases; don't treat 'bag' as limitless storage. For new acquisitions, prefer explicitly supported compartment placements; when uncertain a short legacy record is permitted for runtime reconciliation but must not conjure bags, duplicate gear, or permit magical pocket storage.
ITEM HANDLING: A backpack/satchel/belt pouch/quiver/magic-tool case provides explicit volume AND weight limits per compartment; no bag-inside-bag. Bags hold contents when taken off or dropped. Items held in the arms cost arm bulk. A missing bag does not hold any items; the engine may infer a previously implied legacy bag during save migration only. Stack qty consumes weight and bulk per unit. Never duplicate or erase items during transfer. World-stored or dropped items stay where left and cannot be retrieved remotely.
ENCUMBRANCE: carry_state is computed by code from inventory and body_profile strength/endurance, using simulation-derived thresholds. comfortable=normal; heavy=slower/heavier stamina burden; overloaded=significant travel/dodge/combat penalties; immobile=no normal locomotion until weight is shed. Weight is real physical mass; magic spells may explicitly offset it only if established and paid for, never by UI fiat. If an item takes time to retrieve (buried pack pocket) apply a realistic cost; quick-access pouches are faster. In combat, only reachable items may be used without a separate retrieval action.
BLACK CLOVER: Ordinary gear, mana-related materials, magic tools, brooms, clothing, medicine and weapons all use this system. GRIMOIRES remain in the established grimoire state, not sold or re-created as ordinary inventory. No STGAAB essences, magic stones currency, race modifiers, Labyrinth-specific names or medieval armor catalog. Money stays yul. All default item sizes and carry thresholds are GAMEPLAY INFERENCES, not numerical canonical Black Clover lore.
INVENTORY COMMAND FORMAT: example [inventory: push {"id":"it-rope-17","name":"Hemp rope","qty":1,"weight":2,"bulk":5,"type":"tool","tags":["rope","tool"],"place":"bag","placement":{"kind":"container","containerId":"it-pack-1","slotId":"main"}}]. New item must physically fit; obtain a real bag if needed. New equipped item: {"kind":"body","slot":"main-hand"}; world item: {"kind":"world","area":"ground","location":"exact known place"}. Never double-apply successful UI moves, purchases or returns.
CLOTHING & APPEARANCE: Ordinary garments (upper, lower, full outfit and underlayers) are real equipment layers. Empty slots do not imply nakedness unless appearance_state confirms genuine coverage gaps. Legacy clothing is preserved; a one-time migration of missing pre-update starter clothes prevents accidental stripping. See Visible Equipment, Clothing & Social Perception law.
NO-AI LOCAL ACTIONS: ordinary equip, remove, item rearrangement, examination of recorded properties and ordinary eating/drinking are engine-local. Complex item effects, magic, fights, NPC actions or investigation use explicit story actions instead.
CASH AND STORAGE v21.4: cash carried is money (integer Yul value), not one physical coin/item per Yul. A deterministic denomination model turns value into notes+coins for realistic purse mass, included in carry_state; 6,425 Yul is about 0.0425 kg, NOT 9.6 kg. Money held in the bank has no carried weight. Only genuine physical specie stacks (not wallet duplication) are inventory items. Home storage is limited to 150 kg and 150 bulk at home_location; squad locker storage to 100 kg and 100 bulk at the current squad headquarters, with current squad affiliation. World storage never teleports and stored bags preserve physical contents. See Banking & Treasury Mechanics.

entries.name: Visible Equipment, Clothing & Social Perception (detail)
entries.content:
VISIBLE APPEARANCE — PHYSICAL WORLD RULE
The player's equipment inventory is the authoritative physical source of what they are wearing, carrying, wielding or have taken off. `appearance_state` is a compact engine-derived summary of visible coverage, ordinary clothing, armor, drawnWeapons, notableGear, and location; it updates immediately when UI actions occur, without any AI call. Never treat a hat, armor slot or a missing record as proof of being naked. Previous-version saves can have ordinary clothing recovered as a one-time migration. `equipment_activity` records only a short rolling sample of recent free local actions; these are already completed and should NEVER be duplicated, recharged, or re-narrated as if the player just decided them.
SOCIAL REALISM: When someone plausibly sees the player during an ACTUAL GM narration or conversation, consider current visible appearance and current setting. Undressed/partially dressed in a public market, school, church, barracks, formal event or squad hall generally attracts attention, but responses vary: avert eyes, give space, whisper, stare, laugh, express concern, challenge, call security, offer a cloak, or say nothing. In a bedroom, bath, infirmary, swimming place or other legitimate private/intimate context, exposure may be ordinary. Characters have personalities, roles, senses, social expectations, relationships, age and competing priorities. Do not sexualize minors; describe social boundaries and embarrassment neutrally. Armor and weapons are context-sensitive: a drawn blade in an audience chamber provokes caution; sheathed equipment in a Magic Knight barracks is routine. Rare, unusually ornate or visibly enchanted gear MAY draw inquiry, admiration, envy or suspicion, especially from interested NPCs. Average clothes and weapons ordinarily draw no remark. No routine compliments or repeat reactions on every scene.
PERCEPTION & MEMORY: NPCs can react ONLY if physically present, able to see the outfit/gear, and have reason to notice. A remote NPC knows nothing from UI events. If a witnessed meaningful change affected a persistent character, maintain continuity naturally; do not create witnesses or reputation changes just because a click happened. Consider the current appearance at the next relevant narrated social moment, not merely the last equipment_activity entry, so changing clothes back matters. Only write downstream social consequences when concrete interaction warrants them. Do not override, rewind, or duplicate any equipment action or world_time changes committed by UI.
ACTION COSTS: UI equip/unequip/stow/drop/transfers and ordinary examine/local food use are computed by the UI and include their own elapsed time and free deterministic flavor descriptions. They do not call the model, add to the chat transcript, or consume AI credits. Only intentional 'Use in story (AI)'/'Inspect in story (AI)', complex magical/tool effects, combat, significant environmental consequences or natural chat turns need a GM response. Never require an AI turn for ordinary clothing changes. If an attempted use is extraordinary (spellcasting, medicine, suspicious magic item, weapon attack, NPC response), validate it in normal story resolution; no automatic success from the button.
OTHER CHARACTERS: Apply the same observable clothing/armor/weapon logic to NPCs whose appearance and possessions are established in the living-world records, without conjuring clothing or reacting to equipment that an NPC cannot physically see. Do not assume any NPC is naked just because the player inventory system does not store NPC wardrobe items.
SOCIAL DECENCY: appearance_state.coverage can be dressed, partially_dressed, underdressed (only underwear), or undressed. Visible underwear is not the same as public dress; judge actual visible coverage and context. Never mistake shoes, gloves or accessories for covering the torso or lower body.
CLASS-CONSCIOUS FOLLOW-THROUGH: At every genuinely witnessed social encounter in Clover, compare established social origin (royal/noble/commoner/peasant), NPC prejudice and rank, current visible dress/quality/condition, court or street etiquette, recognized squad standing, relationship, and plausible knowledge. A commoner or peasant may be snubbed even in fine clothes; a noble in rags may lose face. Use the conditional Clover Class Prejudice, Clothing & Social Etiquette lore when active. Make discrimination situational and consequential, not a compulsory remark on every turn. NPCs know only what they can see or have learned.

entries.name: Spell Mechanics Ledger (detail)
entries.content:
SPELL MECHANICS LEDGER v2 — ONE AUTHORITATIVE CALCULATOR FOR UI AND NARRATIVE CASTS
Core invariant: narrative spellcasting and UI buttons use the SAME bcCastPlan and bcImpact functions in bc-spell-engine.js, the same stored spells[] mechanics, and the same mana_reserve / spell_ledger variables. The AI NEVER directly guesses, deducts, or overrides mana/stamina/fatigue for these registered casts. It chooses only in-world circumstances, which stored spell is attempted, output, the freeform scope when relevant, target, hit outcome and defense. The engine computes and applies the numerical results after your reply's bracket directives have been parsed.
STORED SPELLS: spells[] contain id, name, proficiency, and persistent mechanics {version,tier,energyType,manaUnits,stamina,fatigue,impact,range,form,duration}. If you refer to a recorded spell, use its EXACT saved id, not an invented spell or guessed name. Store mechanics ONCE on manifestation; natural proficiency and control changes are factored into cost automatically without changing the baseline. Major breakthroughs may explicitly update the stored mechanics once. Utility cantrips retain 0 tracked mana cost.
NARRATIVE PLAYER CAST (typed chat without UI receipt): when the player attempts actual magic, FIRST decide whether it is a recorded spell or a freeform attempt. Then emit ONE unique CAST event at the end of your reply (with the other state directives):
[spell_events: push {"id":"cast-unique-key","kind":"cast","actor":"player","spellId":"sp-exact-existing-id","output":"Normal"}]
Choose output from Restrained, Normal, Full, Overdrawn. A CAST event is required for a failed/missed/blocked spell once the character genuinely RELEASED the magic; such attempts still pay the cost. Do NOT emit it for an unattempted request, a thought, an interrupted cast before energy is released, or a purely verbal reference to a spell.
NARRATIVE FREEFORM CAST: use exactly ONE cast event with {"id":"cast-unique-key","kind":"cast","actor":"player","spellId":"freeform","freeform":true,"tier":"small","output":"Normal"} and the correct tier from utility, small, standard, large, massive. Freeform scope is determined by intended size/complexity, not chosen randomly to favor an outcome. The engine calculates its higher freeform expenditure using the same reservoir, control and output rules; it DOES NOT automatically manifest a grimoire spell. Track the experiment / breakthrough separately in spell_concepts or spells when causally earned.
NPC CAST: a persistent NPC must already have world_truth.npcs[exact-key] with magic_profile:{capacity,output,control,...}, manaUnits: number, and spells:[{id,name,mechanics,proficiency}]. If necessary, establish that durable profile this turn BEFORE appending the event, never invent a fresh reserve for each cast. Then emit [spell_events: push {"id":"cast-unique-npc-key","kind":"cast","actor":"exact-npc-key","spellId":"existing-npc-spell-id","output":"Normal"}]. The same engine charges NPC mana/stamina/fatigue and retains the lower reserve. Characters with no mana cannot cast normal mana spells; Anti-Magic requires an actual established source and energyType=anti_magic.
HIT/DEFENSE EVENT: after a paid cast, for each target actually contacted, append a second event referencing the SAME cast event id, for example:
[spell_events: push {"id":"impact-unique-key","kind":"impact","actor":"player","castId":"cast-unique-key","target":"exact-npc-key","outcome":"hit","defense":"partial"}]
For a player's receipt from a UI cast, set castId to the saved UI receipt (cast-N) and do NOT emit an additional cast event. In a single GM reply, put the cast directive BEFORE linked impacts. Supported outcomes: miss, dodged, blocked, graze, partial, hit, direct; defenses: none, partial, guarded, barrier, absorbed. A blocked/missed attack may be represented by one impact event, but it has zero damage; a non-harmful contact uses harmful:false. Multi-target spells use ONE cast and a unique impact ID PER ACTUAL TARGET, not another cast cost per hit. Persisted NPC target keys must exist; the player target key is "player".
RESOURCE OWNERSHIP: Never also emit [mana: -N], [stamina: -N], [fatigue: +N], [vitality: -N], NPC manaUnits deduction or manual damage for the SAME registered cast or magical impact. The engine applies them atomically and records receipts in spell_ledger.results. The player's existing mana is a percentage projection of mana_reserve.currentUnits. The engine rejects unknown spell ids, unknown NPCs, duplicates, insufficient reserves and invalid outputs; no resource cost or damage is applied for rejected events. Before narrating a successful cast, consult current spells[], the mana_reserve and magic_profile to avoid describing an impossible outcome; the bridge cannot rewind prose it has already received. Never claim that an unregistered chat action was auto-deducted.
FICTION: Resolve placement, accuracy, timing, counterspells, cover, shields, injuries and state-changing magical effects causally. Impact scores are NOT direct hit points. Healing, utility, sealing, restraints and terrain changes need appropriate state directives for their NON-damage results; never run the harmful damage formula on a harmless effect. Physical strikes and unusual energy systems keep their established rules.
LEGACY COMPATIBILITY: Previous [spell_events: push {"id":"impact-unique","actor":"player","castId":"cast-N",...}] UI impacts remain supported. Previous NPC impact-only events with a spellId remain supported via a one-time legacy cast receipt, but prefer the two-event contract above. Every event ID must be UNIQUE and stay stable; use the same id only to reference the same event. Do not reuse an id on later turns.

storySummary.focus: Keep: where the character lives and is now, the date, injuries and conditions, money owed or promised, every promise, debt and favor (who owes whom), how each named NPC feels about the character and why, grimoire/spell milestones, squad and rank changes, crimes and witnesses, and every way the story has diverged from canon.

reactions.name: World Churn (engine roll)
reactions.description: Engine-side dice, no extra AI call: about one turn in eight (never twice within six turns) the narrator is told to surface one small piece of independent world life.

event.message: WORLD CHURN (engine roll): in the next reply, where the character could plausibly notice it, let ONE small piece of independent world life surface — an overheard rumor, a minor local event, a known NPC acting on their own goals, news or a letter from elsewhere, a shift in prices or supply, or a stranger with a problem. Pick what fits this place and hour, vary it from last time, keep it brief and organic. Not a quest; the player may ignore it. Record anything lasting in state.

reactions.name: New Day — Weather & Schedules
reactions.description: When the date changes, remind the narrator once to roll the weather forward and let schedules move.

event.message: NEW DAY: carry the weather forward for this season and region with small variation (write weather if it changed), and let NPC schedules, shop hours and pending deadlines move with the date.

variables.name: Character Created
variables.description: True once the five-page creator has been committed.
variables.behaviorRules: Set by the creation screen.

variables.name: Creation Profile
variables.description: Every choice from the five creation pages, including typed notes.
variables.behaviorRules: The creation screen's record. Read it for the Life Begins Protocol.

variables.name: Simulation Settings
variables.description: Player-chosen presentation and simulation settings.
variables.behaviorRules: Player settings (settings panel). Obey every field.

variables.name: Name
variables.description: The player character's name.
variables.behaviorRules: Set by the creation screen. Change only if the character legitimately adopts a new name in play (alias, marriage) and the player says so.

variables.name: Age
variables.description: The character's age in years.
variables.behaviorRules: Derived by the interface from birth_date and world_date.

variables.name: Profile
variables.description: Sex, appearance, personality, homeland, citizenship, social origin, lineage, race, birth date.
variables.behaviorRules: birth_date is already set by the creation screen — read it, never invent or change it. Initialize everything else at Life Begins from creation_profile. Update only for lasting changes: citizenship, notable scars, a changed social standing, a legal name change.

variables.name: Occupation
variables.description: What the character currently does for a living or with their days.
variables.behaviorRules: Set at Life Begins; update when the character takes, changes or loses a job or role (e.g. 'Farmhand at the Tolven farm', 'Junior Magic Knight, Black Bulls').

variables.name: Date
variables.description: Current world date, format 'D Month, CY N' (CY 0 = the year Asta and Yuno turn fifteen).
variables.behaviorRules: Set at Life Begins. Change whenever a day passes: [world_date: set "21 March, CY 0"].

variables.name: Time
variables.description: Current world time, 24-hour HH:MM.
variables.behaviorRules: Advance EVERY turn by realistic elapsed time: [world_time: set "07:45"].

variables.name: Days Lived Here
variables.description: Days since the save began.
variables.behaviorRules: Add the number of days passed whenever the date changes: [elapsed_days: +1].

variables.name: Weather
variables.description: Short phrase for current local weather.
variables.behaviorRules: Update when weather changes or the character moves to a different region (e.g. 'Cold, clear, strong wind').

variables.name: Location
variables.description: Where the character is right now: place — settlement (kingdom, region).
variables.behaviorRules: Update whenever the character moves between places or arrives somewhere, e.g. 'Grimoire Tower — Hage (Clover, Forsaken Realm)'.

variables.name: Home
variables.description: Where the character currently lives.
variables.behaviorRules: Update only when the character actually relocates their residence.

variables.name: Scene Type
variables.description: Context for the interface shortcuts.
variables.behaviorRules: One of: home, street, shop, tavern, tower, church, workplace, training, squad_hq, wilderness, travel, dungeon, combat, ceremony, other. Update when the kind of scene changes.

variables.name: Vitality
variables.description: Hidden bodily reserve for continuity; injuries themselves live in conditions.
variables.behaviorRules: Decrease with injury: minor -3 to -8, moderate -8 to -15, serious -15 to -30, critical -30 to -50. Recover +1 to +5 per day with rest; faster with competent healing magic. 0 = dying; outcome follows sim_settings.consequences.

variables.name: Stamina
variables.description: Physical energy for exertion.
variables.behaviorRules: Spend on exertion: brisk walk -1 to -3 per hour, hard labor -5 to -10 per hour, sprinting or fighting -5 to -20 per exchange. Recover +10 to +30 per hour of rest; a full night's sleep restores to 90-100.

variables.name: Mana
variables.description: Percent of current mana capacity available now.
variables.behaviorRules: 0–100 displayed percent of exact mana_reserve.currentUnits/maxUnits; absolute mana units stored by UI based on magic_profile.capacity. Routine utility/cantrips cost ZERO tracked mana. UI cast receipts already debit; never deduct twice. Recovery from rest/training and GM-directed ordinary activity updates percent, then engine reconciles currentUnits. If capacity=0, a magicless character has no mana regardless of old display.

variables.name: Fatigue
variables.description: Accumulated physical, mana and mental fatigue.
variables.behaviorRules: Hard training day +10 to +20, extreme +25 to +40, hard labor day +8 to +15. Sleep -20 to -35; rest days -30 to -50. Above 80 the character is exhausted: gains fall, mistakes and injury risk rise.

variables.name: Conditions
variables.description: Injuries, illnesses, curses, statuses.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"id","kind","location","type","severity","effects","treatment","healing","since"} on injury or illness; update healing as it progresses; delete by index when fully healed.

variables.name: Magic Profile
variables.description: Hidden magical profile (0-100 human scale) with descriptive bands for the UI.
variables.behaviorRules: Initialize at Life Begins. Numbers change only from resolved training, breakthroughs, injury or age, in small steps (training magnitudes). Refresh the matching band whenever a value crosses a band. Never state the numbers in narration. Capacity 0 = no mana; if intentionally mana-less, record magicless true. Positive capacity uses the engine fixed reserve function. Never generate a fresh max mana figure for the same profile.

variables.name: Body Profile
variables.description: Hidden physical and personal profile (0-100) plus skills.
variables.behaviorRules: Initialize at Life Begins. Change only from resolved training, work, injury and age, in small steps. skills holds named skills with proficiency words (e.g. {"swordsmanship":"Novice"}).

variables.name: Has Grimoire
variables.description: True once a grimoire has chosen the character.
variables.behaviorRules: Set true only when a grimoire actually chooses the character (ceremony or later tower visit). Set false if the grimoire is lost or destroyed.

variables.name: Grimoire
variables.description: The character's grimoire as a physical, soul-bound object.
variables.behaviorRules: Set the complete object when received (status, received_on, origin_kingdom, insignia, leaf_count, appearance{cover,color,ornament,size,wear,aura,motif}, pages_filled, blank_potential, special_conditions, spirit_link, devil_link, history). Increment pages_filled and push to history when a page manifests.

variables.name: Spells
variables.description: Grimoire spells the character has manifested.
variables.behaviorRules: Push a complete spell object the moment a page manifests. Update proficiency, prog and variants as they improve. Never add a spell without a manifestation. Every manifested spell has persistent mechanics {version,tier,energyType,manaUnits,stamina,fatigue,impact,range,form,duration} written on first manifestation; fallback profiles are engine-normalized. Do not reroll mechanics per cast. Proficiency and player control/output modulate costs deterministically; a real breakthrough can permanently update mechanics.

variables.name: Spell Concepts
variables.description: Spells under development.
variables.behaviorRules: Push when the character starts shaping a new concept; update state, understanding, stability, control, experience, pressure and notes as it develops; set state MANIFESTED when it becomes a page. Never duplicate an id.

variables.name: Techniques
variables.description: Learned techniques outside the grimoire (Reinforcement, Mana Sensing, Mana Skin, Mana Zone, Mana Method, Ki...).
variables.behaviorRules: Push only when legitimately learned; update tier as it improves.

variables.name: Yul
variables.description: Personal funds in yul (household money is separate).
variables.behaviorRules: Yul value of cash carried in the purse (integer; never one coin per Yul, never mirrored as items). Use +/- for purchases and civilian pay. Knight salary and bank transfers are handled by the interface — never [money: +salary].

variables.name: Pack
variables.description: Persistent physical inventory with unique item instances, weight/bulk, per-compartment placement and world location.
variables.behaviorRules: Unique physical item instances: {id,name,qty,cond,weight,bulk,type,tags,slot,placement}. placement = {"kind":"body","slot":"back"} | {"kind":"container","containerId":"it-id","slotId":"main"} | {"kind":"loose"} | {"kind":"world","area":"ground|home|storage|companion","location":"exact place"}. New items must fit a real slot; never conjure bags or move items remotely; the grimoire is never an inventory item. The interface normalizes records and handles UI moves, purchases and storage.

variables.name: Household
variables.description: The character's household and family.
variables.behaviorRules: Initialize at Life Begins: {"members":[{"name","relation","age","occupation","status"}],"wealth","house_name","residence","obligations":[]}. house_name only applies at noble or royal wealth (see Households & Family for how it's assigned and recorded). Update when the household changes (births, deaths, marriages, departures, wealth shifts).

variables.name: Property
variables.description: Homes, rooms and businesses the character owns, rents or can use.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"id","name","type","location","status","rent","storage","notes"} when the character gains access to a residence or property; update when that changes.

variables.name: Affiliations
variables.description: Organizations the character belongs to.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"org","role","rank","since","standing","notes"} when the character joins; update rank and standing; set standing to 'former' when they leave.

variables.name: Magic Knight Record
variables.description: Clover Magic Knight exam, rank (five classes per tier), squad and confirmed individual stars.
variables.behaviorRules: New recruits start at Junior Magic Knight, 5th Class regardless of birth. Promotion is institutional, never automatic (Junior/Intermediate/Senior × 5th→1st). merit = recognition; personal_stars = confirmed individual merit stars only (squad star totals are separate). Salary is paid by the interface — never credit it yourself.

variables.name: Missions
variables.description: Missions, contracts, jobs and favors the character knows of.
variables.behaviorRules: Push what the character knows; update status (offered, accepted, active, completed, failed, abandoned). Hidden truths go in world_truth, not here.

variables.name: Goals
variables.description: The player's own personal goals.
variables.behaviorRules: Written by the UI goal editor. You may push {"goal","status":"active","set_on"} only when the player explicitly states a new goal in chat. Never mark goals complete or abandoned on your own unless the player's actions clearly accomplish them.

variables.name: Known Events
variables.description: Upcoming events, opportunities and world news the character knows about.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"id","title","when","where","kind":"upcoming|opportunity|news|rumor","status":"known|missed|done|taken"} when learned; update status when it resolves. The interface archives old resolved entries.

variables.name: Relationships
variables.description: People the character knows, keyed by NPC id.
variables.behaviorRules: Add or update {"name","role","familiarity","trust","respect","affection","attraction","rivalry","fear","resentment","loyalty","summary","last_seen","status"} for NPCs the character meaningfully interacts with. Values 0-100 describe that NPC's feelings toward the character; change them only from real events (usually 1-8 per meaningful interaction, max about 10 per turn except extreme events). Refresh summary when the relationship shifts.

variables.name: With You
variables.description: People currently traveling or fighting alongside the character.
variables.behaviorRules: Push when someone joins the character; update condition, mana and distance during action; remove when they leave.

variables.name: Reputation
variables.description: Reputation by community or organization.
variables.behaviorRules: Keyed by group: {"band","note"}. Update only through witnessed deeds, stories and rumors that plausibly reached that group.

variables.name: Commitments
variables.description: Promises, debts, favors and obligations.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"kind","who","content","due","status"} when made; update status when kept, broken or settled.

variables.name: Chronicle
variables.description: The character's own history — milestones in their life.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"date","title","category","summary"} for genuine milestones only. The interface archives older pages automatically.

variables.name: Codex
variables.description: What the character knows about people, places, factions, magic, history, rumors, secrets and languages.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"topic","category","text","source"} when the character genuinely learns something noteworthy. Keep text short; merge minor entries past about 60.

variables.name: Known Places
variables.description: Geography the character knows.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {name,kingdom,region,status:visited|known|rumored|approximate,notes,route,x,y} when learned; upgrade status on visiting. x/y = km from the Royal Capital (+x east, +y north): copy from the gazetteer for canon places or from world_truth.geo for generated ones; never move a place once used. If exact coordinates are unknown, give "near":"<known place>","dir":"N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW","km":<number> instead — the interface draws its map from these.

variables.name: Training Job
variables.description: The current training, routine or advance job.
variables.behaviorRules: Set the full job when one starts (kind, focus, secondary, intensity, duration, start, end, location, trainer, interruptions, progress); update progress; set active false when it ends or is interrupted for good.

variables.name: Routine
variables.description: The character's standing schedule and lifestyle automation.
variables.behaviorRules: Written by the routine editor. Read it for ROUTINE time.

variables.name: In Combat
variables.description: True while a fight is underway.
variables.behaviorRules: Set true the moment hostile action begins; set false when the fight ends (victory, retreat, surrender, escape, separation).

variables.name: Combat
variables.description: Visible state of the current fight.
variables.behaviorRules: While fighting: {"active":true,"location","participants":[{"name","key","side","threat":"weak|average|strong|elite|captain","kind":"brute|caster|beast","attribute","condition","distance","notes"}],"objectives":[],"hazards":[]} — only what the character can perceive (threat/kind = honest read of the foe; the battle arena uses them). Reset to {"active":false} when it ends.

variables.name: Canon State (GM only)
variables.description: GM-only default-history ledger.
variables.behaviorRules: GM-only. Keep era, divergence (0-4) and the status of relevant default-history events (DORMANT, APPROACHING, ACTIVE, RESOLVED, HISTORY, ALTERED, PREVENTED) current. Never reveal it.

variables.name: World Truth (GM only)
variables.description: GM-only hidden facts: secrets, true mission threats, rumors, NPC states, geography decisions, sandbox overrides.
variables.behaviorRules: GM-only, never revealed. Record hidden facts the moment you decide them: .npcs, .rumors, .four_leaf, .exam, .settlement, .geo {"<Place>":{x,y,kingdom,realm,kind,reason,places}} for every GENERATED permanent place (before the character learns of it), and .houses {"House <Surname>":{tier,seat,standing,notes}} for every generated noble/royal house — check here before inventing a new one.

variables.name: Current Shop's Stock
variables.description: What the shop the character is currently browsing actually has for sale, if any.
variables.behaviorRules: [{id,name,price,qty,notes}] for the shop being browsed; [] when none. The first time a specific shop is seriously browsed, set its real, price-anchored stock (see Economy & Shops); on later visits reflect what is still there (sold/restocked), never regenerate. Set [] when the character leaves. The Market screen buys from it.

variables.name: Last Training Report
variables.description: Machine-readable line the GM writes once a training block resolves, for the interface to read and clear.
variables.behaviorRules: When a training block resolves, set exactly "hours=<number>;interrupted=<true|false>" (actual training time this reply). The interface then applies stamina, mana, fatigue and the clock — don't write those. Otherwise leave "".

variables.name: Last Travel Report
variables.description: Machine-readable line the GM writes once a travel leg resolves, for the interface to read and clear.
variables.behaviorRules: When a travel leg resolves, set exactly "hours=<number>;interrupted=<true|false>" (actual travel time this reply). The interface then applies stamina, mana, fatigue and the clock; you still write current_location, known_locations, food and money. Otherwise leave "".

variables.name: Position X (km east of Royal Capital)
variables.description: The character's current continental coordinate, km east(+)/west(-) of Royal Capital.
variables.behaviorRules: Mostly interface-owned during travel (see UI:TRAVEL). Set directly only when the creation protocol places the character somewhere other than the default start.

variables.name: Position Y (km north of Royal Capital)
variables.description: The character's current continental coordinate, km north(+)/south(-) of Royal Capital.
variables.behaviorRules: Mostly interface-owned during travel (see UI:TRAVEL). Set directly only when the creation protocol places the character somewhere other than the default start.

variables.name: Physical Carry State
variables.description: Derived physical carry profile from the inventory and hidden body strength; written by inventory engine.
variables.behaviorRules: Derived by the interface from inventory, purse and body_profile. bands: comfortable · heavy (slower, more stamina) · overloaded (big travel/dodge/combat penalties) · immobile.

variables.name: Physical Appearance (derived)
variables.description: UI-computed visible clothing coverage, held weapons and conspicuous gear. Inform social perception, never fabricate witnesses.
variables.behaviorRules: Derived from worn inventory. The observable truth of the character's look; NPCs react only with sight lines, context and reason.

variables.name: Local Equipment Activity
variables.description: Last 6 deterministic equipment actions and their free flavor text. No AI messages or mushies spent.
variables.behaviorRules: Recent free UI equipment actions, already applied. Never replay or re-narrate them.

variables.name: Equipment Event Sequence
variables.description: Monotonic sequence ensuring locally recorded equipment actions have stable identifiers.
variables.behaviorRules: ENGINE-OWNED: never modify by GM.

variables.name: Magic Knight Payroll Ledger
variables.description: Engine-authoritative Magic Knight monthly salary service start, historical rates, payslips and verified performance awards. Automatically paid on in-game calendar movement without GM chat.
variables.behaviorRules: Routine service pay and approved merit bonuses are computed by the deterministic UI/payroll watcher and credited to bank_account, NOT to carried money. Do not rewrite cyclesPaid, salary ledger, totalPaid, bonusPaid or lastPayment. GM may add a distinct authorized bonus object to mk_payroll.bonusAwards with status=approved, unique stable id, positive amount and reason. No GM [money:+salary] and no duplicate awards.

variables.name: Bank & Treasury Account
variables.behaviorRules: UI-OWNED secure Yul ledger. Pay, deposits and withdrawals are applied atomically with mk_payroll or money by the deterministic UI, not by GM narration. Financial counters permit in-person opening/transfers only. Magic Knight salary auto-creates an institutional payroll account, not a portable cash hoard. Offsite bank balance can be viewed but not spent directly at local markets. No interest or invisible charges by default. Never duplicate bank balance into money or inventory.

variables.name: Mana Reserve Units
variables.behaviorRules: Engine-owned mana pool; mana is its percentage. Never write it.

variables.name: Spell Transaction Ledger
variables.behaviorRules: ENGINE-OWNED persistent spell cast receipts, processed event ids and result history. GM references receipt ids but never edits ledger or manufactures costs.

variables.name: Spell Impact Events
variables.behaviorRules: Push one unique kind=cast event per typed released cast and kind=impact events per target struck (see Spell Cost Bridge). The engine processes and clears them.
variables.description: GM-authored spell transactions and impacts, processed by deterministic spell engine for both typed narrative and UI casts.

variables.name: Bank summary
variables.description: Interface-maintained one-line summary of the bank account and knight pay.
variables.behaviorRules: Bank savings and knight pay, kept by the interface. Usable only in person at a staffed bank or treasury; never mirrored into money.

variables.name: Knight bonus requests
variables.description: Authorized one-time Magic Knight bonuses waiting for the payroll office.
variables.behaviorRules: Push {"id","amount","reason","source"} only for a genuinely authorized, funded one-time knight bonus (unique id). The interface pays it to the bank once and clears the list. Never also change money.

variables.name: Chronicle archive
variables.description: Older chronicle pages kept for the player's Journal (not sent to the AI).

variables.name: Resolved events archive
variables.description: Older resolved known_events kept for the Journal (not sent to the AI).

variables.name: Battle record
variables.description: Arena fight results kept for the Crown page (not sent to the AI).

variables.name: Spar practice
variables.description: Per-day spar progress tracker used by the interface (not sent to the AI).

description:
This is a new world card. The old one is having problems. Play this while you wait!

A persistent Black Clover life-and-world simulation. Begin in any kingdom and era; canon is the world's default history, not your script. Five-page creator, a living grimoire, hidden multi-axis growth, living NPCs, economy, travel and continuous combat. · Labyrinth Survival-inspired deterministic physical inventory with compartments, equipment, weight, direct UI transfers, drop/retrieval and migrated saves. Magic Knight salaries and career pay model rebuilt on a 200,000-Yul rookie scale, five-class rank progression, calendar-driven no-AI salary accrual, approved merit bonuses, yen-inspired item costs and class-disparate civilian wages. All new price/pay tables beyond the Asta baseline are simulation estimates. | v21.4: physical home and squad lockers, deposit/withdraw banking, realistic purse denominations, direct-to-treasury Magic Knight salaries. | v21.5: leaner prompt (about half the always-on rules, tighter lore triggers, summary + latest 30 messages), engine-rolled world events, reorganized interface. | v21.8.1: world map land stays aligned with places when zooming. v21.8: battle spells act like their descriptions (lances pierce, shields block, seals seal) with drag-to-aim. v21.7: story screen gives the narration most of the screen (compact header, one action row, Reading mode); distinct interface wording. v21.6.4: bottom bar above page content. v21.6.3: always-present back button. v21.6.2: renamed interface sections, hosted art. v21.6: real-time battle arena (fights and spars, no AI turn spent), a world map the interface draws from the story's own descriptions.

function BankView(p) {
  var api=p.api,v=api.variables||{},bank=bcBankState(v.bank_account),wallet=bcWalletProfile(v.money);
  var here=bcBankHere(v),ready=canWrite(api);
  var amountState=React.useState(''),amount=amountState[0],setAmount=amountState[1];
  var msgState=React.useState(''),msg=msgState[0],setMsg=msgState[1];
  var pending=React.useRef(false);
  var startSignature=React.useRef('');
  var stateSignature=JSON.stringify([v.money,v.bank_account]);
  React.useEffect(function(){if(pending.current&&stateSignature!==startSignature.current) pending.current=false;},[stateSignature]);
  function apply(patch,success){
    if(pending.current||!ready)return;
    pending.current=true;startSignature.current=stateSignature;
    try{
      var result;
      if(typeof api.patchVariables==='function')result=api.patchVariables(patch);
      else Object.keys(patch).forEach(function(k){api.setVariable(k,patch[k]);});
      if(result&&typeof result.then==='function')result.then(function(){setMsg(success);},function(){pending.current=false;setMsg('Transaction could not be saved. Please check the balances before trying again.');});
      else setMsg(success);
    }catch(e){pending.current=false;setMsg('Save failed: '+str(e&&e.message||e));}
  }
  function open(){
    var r=bcBankOpen(v.bank_account,v);
    if(!r.ok){setMsg(r.reason);return;}
    apply(Object.assign({bank_account:r.bank_account},bcClockForInventory(v,5)),'Account opened. Deposits and withdrawals can now be completed at a staffed branch.');
  }
  function transfer(kind,n){
    if(pending.current)return;
    var r=bcBankTransfer(v,kind,n);
    if(!r.ok){setMsg(r.reason);return;}
    var inv=bcNormalize(arr(v.inventory),v);
    var patch=Object.assign({money:r.money,bank_account:r.bank_account,
      carry_state:bcCarryProfile(inv,obj(v.body_profile),bcWalletProfile(r.money).weightKg)},bcClockForInventory(v,3));
    apply(patch,(kind==='deposit'?'Deposited ':'Withdrew ')+bcMoney(n)+'; both balances have been updated.');
    setAmount('');
  }
  var md = React.useState(""); var mode = md[0], setMode = md[1];
  var acctLabel = bank.open ? (bank.accountType && bank.accountType !== "personal" ? bank.accountType : "Stored in the Clover Kingdom Treasury.") : "No account opened yet.";
  function amountBox(kind) {
    return (
      <div className="bc-bank-amount">
        <input className="bc-in" inputMode="numeric" type="number" min="1" step="1" aria-label={kind === "deposit" ? "Amount to deposit" : "Amount to withdraw"} value={amount} onChange={function (e) { setAmount(e.target.value); }} placeholder="Whole Yul" />
        <Btn small kind="gold" disabled={!ready || !here || !bank.open || !(Number(amount) > 0)} onClick={function () { transfer(kind, Number(amount)); }}>{kind === "deposit" ? "Deposit" : "Withdraw"}</Btn>
        {kind === "deposit" ? <Btn small disabled={!ready || !here || !bank.open || wallet.yul <= 0} onClick={function () { transfer('deposit', wallet.yul); }}>All cash</Btn> : null}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Frame className="bc-bank-panel" pad="0 0 8px">
      <SectionHead art="bank_head" icon="bank" title="Bank & Treasury" sub="Safekeep your wealth." />
      <div className="bc-balance">
        <img src={img("bank_balance")} alt="" /><span className="bc-balance-shade" />
        <div><small>Account Balance</small><strong>{num(bank.balance, 0).toLocaleString() + " Yul"}</strong><span>{acctLabel}</span></div>
      </div>
      <div className="bc-note bc-bank-where" style={{ color: here ? C.goldHi : C.muted }}>{here ? "A staffed counter is here: deposits and withdrawals are open." : "Transactions need a visit to a staffed bank or treasury office."}</div>
      {here && !bank.open ? <div style={{ padding: "0 10px 8px" }}><Btn kind="gold" disabled={!ready} onClick={open}>Open a free account</Btn></div> : null}
      <div className="bc-actrows">
        <ActionRow icon="up" title="Deposit Yul" sub="Move Yul from your purse to the bank." expanded={mode === "deposit"} onClick={function () { setMode(mode === "deposit" ? "" : "deposit"); }} />
        {mode === "deposit" ? amountBox("deposit") : null}
        <ActionRow icon="down" title="Withdraw Yul" sub="Take Yul from your bank to your purse." expanded={mode === "withdraw"} onClick={function () { setMode(mode === "withdraw" ? "" : "withdraw"); }} />
        {mode === "withdraw" ? amountBox("withdraw") : null}
        <ActionRow icon="doc" title="Account Details" sub="View history and treasury information." expanded={mode === "details"} onClick={function () { setMode(mode === "details" ? "" : "details"); }} />
        {mode === "details" ? (
          <div className="bc-bank-details">
            <Row k="Purse · spendable cash" v={bcMoney(v.money)} />
            <Row k="Purse weight" v={wallet.weightKg.toFixed(3) + ' kg (' + wallet.pieces + ' pieces)'} />
            <Row k="Account" v={bank.open ? 'Active' : 'Not opened'} />
            {bank.ledger.length ? bank.ledger.slice(-12).reverse().map(function (e, i) { return <Row key={e.id || i} k={str(e.kind) + ' · ' + str(e.at)} v={(e.kind === 'withdraw' ? '-' : '+') + bcMoney(e.amount)} />; }) : <Empty>No banking transactions have been recorded.</Empty>}
            <Btn small disabled={!!api.isStreaming} onClick={function () { send(api, "I ask where the nearest reputable banking or treasury office is and how to reach it."); p.toStory(); }}>Ask where to bank (AI)</Btn>
            <div className="bc-note">Knight salary and approved awards credit this account automatically. Opening and transfers are local and use no AI.</div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {msg ? <div role="status" className="bc-inv-msg">{msg}</div> : null}
    </Frame>
  );
}

function MarketView(p) {
  var api = p.api; var v = api.variables || {}; var busy = !!api.isStreaming; var locs = arr(v.known_locations); var cx = arr(v.codex);
  var shopRe = /shop|market|merchant|smith|baker|store|stall|inn|tavern|trader|emporium/i; var blackRe = /black market|black-market|smuggl|fence|underground|contraband/i;
  var shops = locs.filter(function (l) { return shopRe.test(str(l.name) + " " + str(l.notes)) && !blackRe.test(str(l.name) + " " + str(l.notes)); });
  var shady = locs.filter(function (l) { return blackRe.test(str(l.name) + " " + str(l.notes)); }).concat(cx.filter(function (c) { return blackRe.test(str(c.topic) + " " + str(c.text)); }));

  function ask(t) { send(api, t); p.toStory(); }
  var buyMessage=React.useState(''),buyError=buyMessage[0],setBuyError=buyMessage[1];

    if(!canWrite(api)||num(item.qty,1)<=0)return;
    var price=num(item.price,0);
    if(price<0||num(v.money,0)<price){setBuyError('Not enough yul.');return;}
    var current=bcNormalize(arr(v.inventory),v);
    // A shop-stock entry describes a type, but each purchase makes a new
    // physical instance. Never share the stock id with purchased instances.
    var id='it-bc-'+String(item.id||'stock').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,'-')+'-'+(current.length+1);
    var materialized={id:id,name:str(item.name),qty:1,cond:str(item.cond)||'good',
      type:item.type,weight:item.weight,bulk:item.bulk,slot:item.slot,tags:item.tags,
      storage_profile:item.storage_profile,quality:item.quality,durability:item.durability,
      maxDurability:item.maxDurability,material:item.material,
      notes:str(item.notes),provenance:{source:'shop',price:price,location:str(v.current_location)}};
    var received=bcReceive(current,materialized);
    if(!received.ok){setBuyError(received.reason+' No yul spent.');return;}
    var newStock=stock.slice(),newQty=num(item.qty,1)-1;
    if(newQty<=0)newStock.splice(idx,1);
    else newStock[idx]=Object.assign({},item,{qty:newQty});
    var newMoney=num(v.money,0)-price;
    var patch=Object.assign({money:newMoney,shop_stock:newStock,inventory:received.inventory,
      carry_state:bcCarryProfile(received.inventory,obj(v.body_profile),bcWalletProfile(newMoney).weightKg)},bcClockForInventory(v,2));
    setBuyError('');
    try {
      var result;
      if(typeof api.patchVariables==='function')result=api.patchVariables(patch);
      else Object.keys(patch).forEach(function(k){api.setVariable(k,patch[k]);});
      var hid='[UI:BUY] item='+str(item.name)+'; price='+price+' yul; STATE ALREADY APPLIED. Do not add inventory or deduct money again.';
      if(result&&typeof result.then==='function') {
        result.then(function(){tellGM(api,hid,'I buy the '+str(item.name).toLowerCase()+'.');p.toStory();},function(e){setBuyError('Purchase failed to save.');});
      }else{tellGM(api,hid,'I buy the '+str(item.name).toLowerCase()+'.');p.toStory();}
    }catch(e){setBuyError('Purchase failed: '+str(e&&e.message||e));}
  }
  return (
    <Frame className="bc-market-panel" pad="0 0 8px">
      <SectionHead art="market_head" icon="coins" title="Market" sub="Buy, Sell, and Trade in the Kingdom." />
      {buyError ? <div role="alert" className="bc-inv-msg" style={{ color: "#efb6a5" }}>{buyError}</div> : null}
      {stock.length ? (
        <div className="bc-stock">
          <div className="bc-stock-title">Currently browsing</div>
          {stock.map(function (item, i) {
            var afford = num(v.money, 0) >= num(item.price, 0);
            return (
              <div key={item.id || i} className="bc-stockrow">
                <div><strong>{str(item.name) + (num(item.qty, 1) > 1 ? " ×" + num(item.qty, 1) : "")}</strong>{item.notes ? <small>{str(item.notes)}</small> : null}</div>
                <Btn small disabled={busy || !afford} onClick={function () { buyItem(item, i); }}>{num(item.price, 0).toLocaleString() + " Yul"}</Btn>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="bc-actrows">
        <ActionRow icon="search" title="Look for a shop" sub={shops.length ? "Known: " + shops.slice(0, 3).map(function (l) { return str(l.name); }).join(", ") : "Browse what is nearby."} disabled={busy} onClick={function () { ask("I look for somewhere nearby to buy what I need."); }} />
        <ActionRow icon="coins" title="Sell something" sub="Turn your items into Yul." disabled={busy} onClick={function () { ask("I try to sell something I'm carrying."); }} />
        <ActionRow icon="people" title="Ask around discreetly" sub={shady.length ?       </div>
    </Frame>
  );

/* ---------- background bookkeeping (no AI, no chat) ----------
   Keeps what the AI reads each turn small: archives old chronicle pages and
   resolved events, files authorized knight bonuses into payroll, trims spent
   spell events, and maintains a one-line bank summary instead of exposing
   the full ledgers to the AI. */
function useHousekeeping(api) {
  var v = (api && api.variables) || {};
  var sig = JSON.stringify([v.chronicle, v.known_events, v.mk_bonus_requests, v.bank_account, v.mk_status, v.mk_payroll && v.mk_payroll.totalPaid, v.mk_payroll && v.mk_payroll.cyclesPaid, v.bank_summary, v.spell_events, v.spell_ledger && v.spell_ledger.seq, v.world_date, v.character_created]);
  var attempted = React.useRef("");
  React.useEffect(function () {
    if (!isTrue(v.character_created) || !canWrite(api) || attempted.current === sig) return;
    var patch = {};
    var chron = arr(v.chronicle);
    if (chron.length > 24) { var cut = chron.length - 20; patch.chronicle = chron.slice(cut); patch.chronicle_archive = arr(v.chronicle_archive).concat(chron.slice(0, cut)).slice(-400); }
    var evs = arr(v.known_events); var resolved = evs.filter(function (e) { return e && /^(done|missed|taken|resolved|expired)$/i.test(str(e.status)); });
    if (resolved.length > 5) {
      var old = resolved.slice(0, resolved.length - 5);
      patch.known_events = evs.filter(function (e) { return old.indexOf(e) < 0; });
      patch.events_archive = arr(v.events_archive).concat(old).slice(-300);
    }
    var reqs = arr(v.mk_bonus_requests);
    // Wait while a payroll transition is pending so the two writers never race on mk_payroll.
    if (reqs.length && !bcMKPayrollStep(v)) {
      var pay = obj(v.mk_payroll); var awards = arr(pay.bonusAwards).slice();
      reqs.forEach(function (r) {
        r = obj(r); var id = str(r.id).trim(); var amt = Math.floor(num(r.amount, 0));
        if (!id || amt <= 0 || awards.some(function (a) { return a && a.id === id; })) return;
        awards.push({ id: id, amount: amt, reason: str(r.reason) || "Approved service merit", source: str(r.source) || "Squad command", status: "approved", filed: str(v.world_date) });
      });
      patch.mk_payroll = Object.assign({}, pay, { bonusAwards: awards.slice(-80) });
      patch.mk_bonus_requests = [];
    }
    var done = arr(obj(v.spell_ledger).processed); var events = arr(v.spell_events);
    if (events.length) {
      var pending = events.filter(function (e) { return !(e && done.indexOf(str(e.id)) >= 0); });
      if (pending.length !== events.length) patch.spell_events = pending;
    }
    var bank = bcBankState(v.bank_account); var mk = obj(v.mk_status); var comp = bcMKMonthly(mk.rank, mk.personal_stars); var payday = bcMKNextPayday(v);
    var summary = (bank.open ? "Account open, balance " + bcMoney(bank.balance) : "No bank account") +
      (comp.total > 0 ? "; knight pay " + bcMoney(comp.total) + "/month" + (payday ? ", next payday " + payday : "") : "") + ".";
    if (summary !== str(v.bank_summary)) patch.bank_summary = summary;
    if (!Object.keys(patch).length) { attempted.current = sig; return; }
    attempted.current = sig;
    bcPatch(api, patch, function (ok) { if (!ok) attempted.current = ""; });
  }, [sig, !!(api && api.isStreaming)]);
}

/* ---------- battle arena glue: apply results, entry points ---------- */
function applyBattle(api, v, r, opts) {

  var vit = spar ? clamp(num(v.vitality, 100) - Math.round(r.taken * 0.5), 1, 100) : clamp(num(r.hp, 0), 0, 100);
  var manaFrac = maxU ? (num(r.units0, 0) - units) / maxU : 0;
  var minutes = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.seconds / 20)) + (spar ? 20 : 0);
  var patch = Object.assign({

    fatigue: clamp(num(v.fatigue, 0) + Math.round(r.seconds / 25 + manaFrac * 10 + r.taken / 10 + (spar ? 3 : 0)), 0, 100)
  }, bcClockForInventory(v, minutes));
  if (maxU) { patch.mana = bar; patch.mana_reserve = { version: 1, maxUnits: maxU, currentUnits: Math.round(units * 100) / 100, capacityBasis: num(obj(v.magic_profile).capacity, 0), percent: bar, lastPercent: bar }; }
  var log = arr(v.battle_log).slice();
  log.push({ date: str(v.world_date), time: str(v.world_time), mode: r.mode, outcome: r.outcome, grade: r.grade, seconds: r.seconds, foes: r.foes.map(function (f) { return f.name; }), where: parseLoc(v.current_location).settlement || "" });
  patch.battle_log = log.slice(-40);
  if (spar) {
    // Practice counts: each spell used gains a little progress, once per in-world day.
    var today = str(v.world_date), done = obj(v.spar_practice), nextDone = Object.assign({}, done), gained = [];
    var spells = arr(v.spells).map(function (sp) {
      var u = r.spellsUsed.filter(function (m) { return m.id === str(sp.id) || m.id === str(sp.name); })[0];
      if (!u || done[str(sp.id) || str(sp.name)] === today) return sp;
      nextDone[str(sp.id) || str(sp.name)] = today; gained.push(u.name);
      return Object.assign({}, sp, { prog: clamp(num(sp.prog, 0) + Math.min(4, 1 + u.uses), 0, 100) });
    });
    if (gained.length) { patch.spells = spells; patch.spar_practice = nextDone; }
    bcPatch(api, patch, function (ok) {
      if (typeof api.showToast === "function") api.showToast(ok ? "Sparring done (" + r.grade + "). " + (gained.length ? "Practice gained: " + gained.join(", ") + "." : "Spells already practiced today.") + " No AI turn used." : "Couldn't save the sparring result.", ok ? "success" : "error");
    });

  }
  var npcs = Object.assign({}, obj(obj(v.world_truth).npcs)), npcChanged = false;
  var parts = arr(obj(v.combat).participants).map(function (pt) {
    pt = obj(pt); var f = r.foes.filter(function (x) { return x.name === str(pt.name); })[0];
    if (!f) return pt;
    if (f.persisted && npcs[f.key]) { npcs[f.key] = Object.assign({}, obj(npcs[f.key]), { vitality: f.hpPct }); npcChanged = true; }
    return Object.assign({}, pt, { condition: f.outcome === "defeated" ? "defeated" : f.outcome });
  });
  patch.combat = Object.assign({}, obj(v.combat), { participants: parts, resolved: r.outcome });
  if (npcChanged) patch.world_truth = Object.assign({}, obj(v.world_truth), { npcs: npcs });
  if (r.outcome !== "defeat") { patch.in_combat = false; patch.combat.active = false; }
  if (lost >= 15) {
    var sev = lost >= 45 ? "serious" : lost >= 25 ? "moderate" : "minor";
    patch.conditions = arr(v.conditions).concat([{ id: "battle-" + log.length + "-" + str(v.world_date).replace(/\W+/g, ""), kind: "injury", location: "various", type: "battle wounds", severity: sev, effects: sev === "serious" ? "bleeding, impaired movement" : sev === "moderate" ? "deep bruising, cuts" : "bruises and scrapes", treatment: "", healing: "0%", since: str(v.world_date) }]);
  }
  var title = { victory: "victory", defeat: "defeat", fled: "escape", yielded: "surrender" }[r.outcome];
  var hidden = "[UI:BATTLE] The fight was PLAYED OUT in the battle arena and its results are ALREADY APPLIED to state. Outcome: " + r.outcome.toUpperCase() +
    " after about " + Math.max(1, Math.round(r.seconds / 20)) + (Math.max(1, Math.round(r.seconds / 20)) === 1 ? " minute" : " minutes") + " of fighting. Foes: " + r.foes.map(function (f) { return f.name + " (" + f.outcome + ")"; }).join(", ") +
    ". The character took " + r.taken + " damage (vitality " + r.hp0 + "→" + vit + "), spent " + Math.round(manaFrac * 100) + "% of their mana" +
    (r.spellsUsed.length ? " casting " + r.spellsUsed.map(function (m) { return m.name + " ×" + m.uses; }).join(", ") : " without spells") +
    "; best combo " + r.bestCombo + ", " + r.perfect + (r.perfect === 1 ? " perfect dodge, " : " perfect dodges, ") + r.interrupts + (r.interrupts === 1 ? " interrupted attack" : " interrupted attacks") + (r.log.length ? "; moments: " + r.log.join("; ") : "") +
    ". Narrate the end of this fight and its immediate aftermath in prose that matches this result exactly (a short, vivid summary, not a blow-by-blow replay). " +
    "Do NOT write vitality, stamina, fatigue, mana, mana_reserve, conditions, in_combat, combat or world_time for it, and emit no spell_events for these casts — all already applied. " +
    "You still own the consequences: what defeated or fled foes do next, loot actually present, witnesses, reputation, crimes, and relationships." + (r.outcome === "defeat" ? " The character has collapsed; what the enemy does now is decided by them and the world (in_combat is still true — you own combat and in_combat from here)." : "");
  bcPatch(api, patch, function (ok) {
    if (!ok) { if (typeof api.showToast === "function") api.showToast("Couldn't save the battle result.", "error"); return; }

  });
}

      <Frame pad="6px 12px 8px" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <Row k="Real fights" v={fights.length + " (" + wins + " won)"} />

      </Frame>
    </div>
  );
}
function SparCard(p) {

    <button type="button" className="bc-sparcard" disabled={busy || isTrue(v.in_combat)} onClick={p.onSpar}>

      <Icon n="chevr" s={14} />
    </button>
  );
}

  if (api && typeof api.resolveAssetUrl === "function") ART_RESOLVE = function (ref) { return api.resolveAssetUrl(ref); };
